verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a backend data platform like Firebase, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no retention policies, TTL or auto-expiry, or data-deletion controls. The nearest items are general data interaction via the CLI and MCP server, user import/export, and flushing the local emulator database between tests. These are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
